name: Saxony-Anhalt
summary: Two horizontal bands of yellow over black with the state arms: Saxon black and gold bars with a green crancelin, and the black bear of Anhalt walking on a red wall.
origin: The state was re-established in 1990 from the former Prussian province of Saxony and the state of Anhalt. Its flag was adopted in 1991.

symbols.name: Anhalt bear
symbols.description: A black bear walking on a red wall.

symbols.name: Saxon bars
symbols.description: Black and gold bars with a green crancelin.

facts: Baden-Württemberg's flag has the same colours in reverse order.
clues: Yellow over black with arms showing a bear on a wall.
Its colours are the reverse of a south-western state's.
Its bear comes from a former duchy.
